          Incoming request
                 |
                 v
 +----------------------------------+   over limit
 |  Rate limit per client IP        |--------------> 429 Too Many Requests
 |  1 request/s, burst of 10        |
 |  X-Real-IP / X-Forwarded-For     |
 |  only with TrustProxy            |
 +---------------+------------------+
                 |
                 v
 +----------------------------------+   no
 |  TOTP enabled?                   |--------------> handle request
 +---------------+------------------+
                 | yes
                 v
 +----------------------------------+   yes
 |  Public path?                    |--------------> handle request
 |  /login, /api/login, /css, /img  |
 +---------------+------------------+
                 | no
                 v
 +----------------------------------+   no
 |  Valid session cookie?           |--------------> redirect to /login
 +---------------+------------------+                        |
                 |                                           v
                 | yes, session           +-------------------------------+   invalid
                 | extended by 5 min      |  POST /api/login              |----------> /login
                 v                        |  verify TOTP code             |
          handle request                  +---------------+---------------+
                                                          | valid
                                                          v
                                          +-------------------------------+
                                          |  Set session cookie           |
                                          |  32 random bytes, HttpOnly,   |
                                          |  SameSite=Strict, Secure on   |
                                          |  HTTPS, then redirect to /    |
